items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Eddie was playing lead alto and Dan was playing third alto.

ctx.x: Who would take the clarinet solos?

Between Eddie Miller and myself. I was playing ten at the time and Eddie was playing lead alto and Dan was playing third alto. So Eddie played most of the clarinet, and most of the clarinet worked at the time.
What did Dan do on third alto? Would he play any solos much? Very seldom.
